- For each verse from startBottles down to startBottles - takeDown + 1:
  - Line 1: "{N} green bottles hanging on the wall," (if N==1 then "bottle")
  - Line 2: Same as above
  - Line 3: "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"
  - Line 4: "There'll be {n-1} green bottles hanging on the wall." (if n-1==1 then "bottle"; if 0 then "no green bottles")
  - Separate verses with an empty string "" between them.

Numbers are spelled out in words and title-cased: "Ten", "Nine", ..., "One", "no".

All tests pass. The implementation in `bottle_song.go`:

- **`bottlePhrase(n)`** — builds a phrase like `"ten green bottles"` or `"one green bottle"` (singular when `n == 1`, `"no green bottles"` when `n == 0`) using a small word map.
- **`title(s)`** — capitalizes only the first letter, applied to the first two lines of each verse. The `"There'll be ..."` line stays lowercase (`nine`, `two`, `one`, `no`), matching the spec.
- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — emits `takeDown` verses counting down from `startBottles`, inserting an empty string *between* verses but not after the last one.
